items.title: Qualified financial context is not complete economic underwriting

items.requiredEvidenceOrDecision: If owner requires 2026-11-05/current underwriting, the inspected retained display-price set ends 2026-10-30. No compatible later price is present in that set; existing quote cannot be relabelled current. No acquisition authorized. Unknown publication dates cannot be reconstructed by assumption.

methodologyExecutableDefect.basis: Static completeness/human assessment, sector normalization and fail-closed M4 contracts inspected. No formal scoring/decision or whole-release testing executed. Legacy same-PDF cohort proof is not expanded into new calculations; no method changes proposed.

minimumUnblockPlan: Owner selects one bounded valuation/as-known/source policy package (U3), without reconfirming settled personal facts.
Map/challenge TCB retained economic schedules and issuer action/common-capital bridges (U1).
Qualify every required nonfinancial topic; isolate genuinely absent industry/share evidence before proposing a finite source-authority request (U2).
Prepare and obtain actual approvals for bounded economic scenarios and model inputs (U4).
Only after evidence completeness: independent dated admission/portfolio/market/lot/opportunity-cost acceptance and separate formal workflow authorization (U5; U6 only if cutoff requires absent data).
sufficientSetCaveat: These are necessary cross-cutting dependency packages, not a promise that five approvals alone make 23 rubrics ready. All individual required topics in the matrix must pass. No unblock step executed.
